tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to encounter, meet, befall, happen, come to meet
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to encounter, meet
1a2) to befall
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to encounter, meet (without pre-arrangement)
1b2) to chance to be present
1b3) to come to meet
1c) (Hiphil) to cause to meet, appoint

1) to build with beams
1a) (Piel) to lay the beams of, furnish with beams

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to light upon (chiefly by accident); causatively, to bring about; specifically, to impose timbers (for roof or floor)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: appoint, lay (make) beams, befall, bring, come (to pass unto), floor, (hap) was, happen (unto), meet, send good speed.
